primary_domain: 文艺/社会观察/个人修养
historical_significance: 沈幅（约前100年-公元180年），东汉时期文学家和官员。他以其敏锐的社会观察和独特的散文风格而闻名，其作品提供了关于东汉社会生活、人际关系和个人修养的珍贵记录。他主张通过个人经验和情感真实性来理解世界，其文学作品被视为东汉散文的重要典范，影响了后世的文人墨客和社会观察传统。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 通过个人经验记录社会观察，强调情感真实性和生活细节的重要性
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Recording social observation through personal experience, emphasizing emotional authenticity and the importance of life details

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 描绘东汉社会生活细节，反映普通人的生活处境
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Depicting details of Han dynasty society, reflecting the living conditions of ordinary people

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 探讨人际关系中的情感真实性与道德界限
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Exploring emotional authenticity and moral boundaries in interpersonal relationships

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 主张通过个人修养来实现世界理解
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Advocating personal cultivation as a means to understand the world

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 文艺创作中的情感表达优于形式规范
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Emotional expression in literary creation takes precedence over formal norms

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 关注生活中的小确幸与生活品质
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Focusing on small joys in life and quality of living

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 批判虚伪的社会风气与虚浮的官场
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Critiquing pseudo-social customs and superficial officialdom

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 探索个人在社会中的位置与归属感
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Exploring one's position in society and sense of belonging

cross_references.description_zh: 沈幅活动于东汉时期，与战国 이후 중국知识传统的演变有关联
cross_references.description_en: Shen Fu active during Han dynasty, related to the evolution of Chinese knowledge tradition after Warring States
